# Vendored third-party code

Used only by `gt4_host` (`-DGT4_BUILD_HOST=ON`). Licences and attribution: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

## fidelityfx-fsr2/

AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.2.1 (MIT), from https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR2,
tag `v2.2.1`: the contents of `src/ffx-fsr2-api/` without the DirectX 12 backend, the Windows shader
compiler and the prebuilt libraries (`ffx_*.{h,cpp}`, `shaders/`, `vk/ffx_fsr2_vk.{h,cpp}`,
`vk/shaders/ffx_fsr2_shaders_vk.h`). The files are unmodified.

- The SDK's precompiled shader permutation tables (`vk/shaders/ffx_fsr2_shaders_vk.cpp`, generated by the
  Windows-only `FidelityFX_SC.exe`) are not used: `cmake/Host.cmake` compiles the GLSL passes with
  glslang, and `platform/render/upscale/fsr2_shaders.cpp` provides `fsr2GetPermutationBlobByIndexVK` with
  reflection read back from that SPIR-V. This keeps the Linux build self-contained.
- At build time the passes are compiled from a copy of `shaders/` in the build directory in which two
  storage-image format qualifiers of `ffx_fsr2_callbacks_glsl.h` are corrected to the formats the FSR 2
  runtime creates (see `cmake/Host.cmake`). The vendored files stay as published.
- `platform/render/upscale/ffx_compat.h` is force-included when compiling the runtime: Vulkan entry points from
  volk, and portable definitions of two MSVC CRT helpers for GCC and Clang.

## fidelityfx-sdk/

AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (MIT), from https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, tag `v1.1.4`
(commit `c6efa6bf`), for FSR 3.1 (PLAN.md B17): the upscaler only. The FSR 3 upscaler component
(`src/components/fsr3upscaler/`), its GLSL passes (`src/backends/vk/shaders/fsr3upscaler/`) and the headers they
include (`include/FidelityFX/gpu/`: the core, `fsr3upscaler/`, `fsr1/` and `spd/`), the Vulkan backend
(`src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp`), the host interface (`include/FidelityFX/host/`), and the shared sources
(`src/shared/`, `src/backends/shared/ffx_shader_blobs.h`): the `#include` closure of the component, the backend
and the passes, 54 files, with `LICENSE.txt`. Nothing of the SDK's frame generation (frame interpolation, optical
flow, its swapchain) is here, not even unused.
- The files are unmodified. `MANIFEST.txt` lists each with its upstream git blob hash and SHA-256: `git hash-object
  FILE` equals the first column. They are LF as upstream has them, and `.gitattributes`' `third_party/** -text`
  keeps git from converting them.
- Not yet built (B17 step 1's next piece): the passes will be compiled with glslang and the SDK's shader blobs
  (`ffx_shader_blobs.cpp`, not vendored) replaced by our own, as for FSR 2 above.

## stb/

`stb_image.h` 2.30 (public domain or MIT) from https://github.com/nothings/stb, commit `003501f6`: decodes
texture packs' PNG files (`platform/gsnative/texture_pack.cpp`). Unmodified.

`stb_image_write.h` 1.16 (public domain or MIT), same repository and commit: writes the problem dump's frames as
PNG (`platform/sdl/renderer.cpp`; its implementation in `platform/sdl/stb_image_write_impl.cpp`). Unmodified.

`stb_truetype.h` 1.26 (public domain or MIT), same repository and commit: reads the bundled UI fonts
(`assets/ui/fonts/`) and renders their glyphs as signed distance fields (`platform/ui/host/sdf_font.cpp`; its
implementation in `platform/ui/host/stb_truetype_impl.cpp`). Unmodified. It is not hardened against hostile font
files: it only ever reads those bundled fonts.

## xxhash/

`xxhash.h` and `LICENSE` (BSD-2-Clause) from https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash, tag `v0.8.3`: the hashes
of texture pack names (`platform/gsnative/texture_name.cpp`). Unmodified.

## smaa/

SMAA (MIT-style licence, `smaa/LICENSE.txt`), from https://github.com/iryoku/smaa: `SMAA.hlsl` (included
by `platform/render/shaders/smaa.*` with `SMAA_GLSL_4`) and the precomputed lookup textures
`Textures/AreaTex.h` and `Textures/SearchTex.h`. Unmodified.
